ownership: Root proposed a necessary surface test of the already discussed stable class-partition writer. bounded_idea_supply checked the theorem and predecessor distinction without reading native words, edges, counts or results.
contract: Partition the actually observed working units into at least two nonempty classes with one fixed total order. A unit has one globally fixed class, and the class ranks never decrease while reading any complete written group. Class sizes are unrestricted; no numeric, sound or semantic values are assigned. A single chosen reading direction applies to every group.
graph: Make one vertex per active working unit and an edge a->b for every directly adjacent unit pair inside an included complete group. Do not add edges across group boundaries. Multiplicity is immaterial to the ordering implication, though source witnesses and their support are separate evidence obligations.
proof: Each edge a->b entails rank(a)<=rank(b). Every directed path entails the corresponding endpoint inequality.
If a and b lie in the same strongly connected component, paths in both directions entail rank(a)<=rank(b) and rank(b)<=rank(a), hence equal ranks. Every SCC must therefore lie inside one class.
If the graph has one SCC on all active units, every unit has the same rank. No nontrivial fixed ordered partition of those units exists.

Conversely, contract each SCC. The condensation graph is a DAG. Any topological ordering assigns component ranks so every edge is nondecreasing. With at least two SCCs this gives a nontrivial partition.

Indeed two ranks suffice whenever there are at least two SCCs: put one source component of the condensation DAG in rank0 and every other component in rank1. No edge enters that source component, so no descending edge is created.

Thus a nontrivial monotone class partition exists exactly when the active graph has at least two SCCs. Reversing the reading direction of EVERY group reverses every edge and preserves the SCC partition; a one-SCC obstruction applies to that global reversal too. Per-group choice of direction is a different contract.
support_scope: The full group population, the separately predeclared subset of whole forms observed at least twice, and the separately predeclared subset occurring on at least two distinct physical leaves are three different support checks. Run the same rule on all three and retain every result, without selecting whichever looks favorable. The physical-leaf diagnostic was added to this proof note at root's prospective selection instruction, without any result exposure.

A recurring-form subgraph may omit some working units entirely. Report its actual active alphabet. Isolated unused labels cannot provide an informative second class, while equality forced only on active units does not constrain omitted signs.

Removing word types only removes edges, so SCCs on retained vertices can split but cannot acquire a new path absent from the full graph. Two-physical-leaf support implies at least two occurrences; its edge set is therefore a subset of the two-occurrence edge set, itself a subset of the full graph. Physical leaves must not be confused with recto/verso page selectors. A weaker recurrent result would identify dependence on excluded forms, not identify a transcription error or validate a repaired writer.
Repeated occurrences are not independent palaeographic confirmation. Whole-group identity and the22-unit parsing remain inherited assumptions.

predecessor_distinction.difference: 886orders complete labels lexicographically and obtains strict symbol precedence from the first unequal position of neighboring labels. This new condition uses every internal adjacent unit and permits equal class ranks for many different units. A directed cycle forces equality here, rather than immediately refuting a strict alphabet order.

IP056sorts complete whole-word forms in a physical line. Its ABAB contradiction does not itself settle weakly ordered within-word unit classes. The old triage warning about weakly motivated universal generators still limits the research interpretation.

The old d,a,l,d cycle forced three equal numeric values and violated that writer's at-most-two-shapes-per-value rule. Here no number or class-size cap is assumed. This is not an added third form or an attempted repair of the closed additive model.

The previous note proves that sorting two stable subsequences loses their original interleaving unless it is paid or restricted by a public source language. The SCC question checks a necessary visible output property before that inverse problem. Neither a nontrivial partition nor a topological order supplies the missing inverse.

interpretation_limits: A one-SCC result would exclude this fixed within-group sorting condition on the included units. It does not exclude directed composition, productive morphology, ordered morpheme slots, context-dependent glyph roles, multiple independent subfields or ordinary language.
A multi-SCC result is structural capacity only. It does not show that a scribe sorted a source, identify the classes, fix a unique order, preserve a message or supply source meanings.

No glyph values, native word values, data count, image, encoder or statistical result is supplied by this review. No new RAW card or reopening of the old tally follows. Root owns any subsequent selection and validation.
